BiblicalUsage: Cozbi was the daughter of Zur, a chief of the Midianites, and her name is tied to the sin at Peor. Numbers 25:15 names her as the Midianite woman Phinehas slew, and Numbers 25:18 says the Midianites beguiled Israel "in the matter of Cozbi."
TheologicalSignificance: What I take from it is that Cozbi stands as a warning written into the record: a single act of seduction drew Israel into idolatry, and the plague that followed cost twenty-four thousand lives.
